build_pack_weights: pack ternary quantized weights into a compact 2-bit-per-value uint8 tensor format
build_unpack_weights: unpack a packed 2-bit-per-value uint8 tensor back into ternary weights with a specified dtype
build_bitnet_linear_layer: build a BitLinear module that performs forward pass with packed ternary weights and per-token activation quantization
build_replace_with_bitnet_linear: replace all nn.Linear layers in a model with BitNet quantized linear layers for inference or training
build_bitnet_deserialize: deserialize packed BitNet weights from a Hugging Face checkpoint by unpacking and converting tensor formats
